headline: Executive order adjusting certain federal pay rates, signed by President Clinton at the end of 1997.
what_it_does: The title says this order adjusts certain rates of pay. Year-end orders with this title usually set new pay rates for federal workers for the coming year, but no summary was provided. The specific pay rates, groups covered, and amounts of any changes cannot be confirmed from the title alone.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may have been adjusted, though the specific groups and amounts are not stated in the title.
